english_intent: What do you do at work/school?

semantic_reframe.pt: Qual é a sua atividade? / Que atividade é a sua?
semantic_reframe.en: What is your activity? / Which activity is yours?
semantic_reframe.context_requirement: The work/school domain is established by the surrounding OPI sequence; the HNK frame does not invent an AT relation or an auxiliary/light DO.

why_v2_is_better_than_v1: KUVAN now separates locative questions in OPI 4/5, removing the former EN VALI KU KE collision.
PHR-003/PHR-006 contrast provides stronger evidence for KU before a nominal content head.
VALA supplies a governed activity nominal head without inventing a verb equivalent to English DO.
The frame reuses the topic context instead of requiring an unrecovered AT/IN relation.
promotion_blockers: KU pre-nominal selector role is inferred, not canonically recovered.
Context-dependent omission of work/school domain requires pedagogical/human validation.
Answer pattern remains to be governed.
